name: 7-card Brag
description: 7-card Brag: seven cards each; make three Brag hands (two of three cards, one of one) or similar layout. Back hand must beat middle, middle must beat front. Same ranks as 3-card Brag. UK.

history.origins: British Brag family; 7-card version uses seven cards in three hands (e.g. 3-3-1); back must beat middle, middle must beat front. Same mechanism as 6-card and 9-card Brag.
timeline: Late 18th century: Three-card Brag in Hoyle
Present: Played in UK and elsewhere

rules.objective: Arrange seven cards into three hands (e.g. back 3, middle 3, front 1) so that back hand beats middle and middle beats front (Brag ranks: prial, run, flush, pair, high). Best valid layout wins.
rules.gameplay: Deal seven cards each. Each player arranges into three hands (e.g. 3-3-1). Showdown: compare back vs back, middle vs middle, front vs front; each comparison must be valid (back > middle > front).
keyRules: Back must beat middle, middle must beat front
Brag hand ranks (prial, run, flush, pair)

strategy.basic: Layout: back > middle > front; use best cards in back.
strategy.intermediate: Balance three hands; avoid invalid layouts.
strategy.advanced: Bluff with weak-looking front; read opponents' structures.
tips: Seven cards into three hands; Brag rankings (prials, runs, flushes).
Back must beat middle, middle must beat front.
